text:
maya: Quick sync: opened PR #7890 to add an SDK quickstart for quota-aware retries and update rate limit header examples. Also noticed one dashboard link is outdated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890  

liam: I can review. Are we changing the header name? I saw suggestions for X-Rate-Cap, X-RateLimit-Limit, and an RW-prefixed variant. Breaking change?

maya: Not breaking. PR introduces an alias chain so older headers keep working, but we should pick a canonical name in the docs. Sanjay proposed namespacing to avoid collisions.

sanjay: I vote for X-RW-Rate-Limit. Keeps it clear it's Redwood-specific. For the SDK snippet, show a fallback lookup so clients handle both old and new names. Example added inline below for clarity: 

```python
# SDK: read rate header with fallbacks
headers = response.headers
rate_limit = headers.get('X-RW-Rate-Limit') or headers.get('X-Rate-Cap') or headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit')
if rate_limit:
    # header format: "1000/second" or "1000"
    limit_val = int(rate_limit.split('/')[0])
    # use limit_val to tune retry/backoff
```

liam: I'll wire that into the python client and add a small unit test asserting fallback order. Also will mirror the same snippet in the JS SDK README.

maya: docs-bot flagged a broken dashboard link in the PR (404).

docs-bot: Link-checker: detected broken URL -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/rate-usage returned 404. Please update.

maya: Updated the PR to point at the new dashboard panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/efgh/usage-ratepanels (commit 4f2b7c). Added a short blurb describing the panel and which metric indicates burst consumption vs sustained throughput.

product-ops: Tiny request: add one sentence that clarifies burst credits are tracked per-customer-id (not per-api-key). A support case showed some customers were confused when their team used multiple keys. Suggested wording left in the PR comment.

liam: Good catch. Ill add that to the migration guide (v1.10 -> v1.11) under "Handling 429s and burst credits" and to the SDK README where we discuss retry semantics. Also adding the unit test that verifies header fallback parsing.

maya: Plan: finish the docs review today, get one more eng signoff, then merge and include a changelog entry under "Rate limits & Quotas" for release 1.12. I'll leave a merge checklist comment in the PR.

sanjay: Ping me after CI passes and I'll sign off on the headers/SDK bits.

maya: Thanks everyone! Leaving a follow-up comment with the merge checklist and the new dashboard panel screenshot.
